svg.text: Register the desktop and finish the deployment
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Create host pool → Workspace → Review + create
Create or select the lab workspace and register the desktop application group. Record the
Review all fields, image, count, region, identity, tags and estimated charges. Choose Create
only after that review and the earlier cost/license gate; otherwise cancel.
Wait for deployment completion and inspect the session-host status in the host pool. Fix
deployment/agent errors rather than repeatedly creating more VMs.
Check: Exactly one intended session host is deployed and available in its pool.
